status: Implemented; recorded focused/client evidence retained and final full/native regressions passed. See the stated verification scope.
device: Original Modbus RTU 7488. Four independent current-limited signal input/output gates, initially high impedance. Source LRDU slots are fixed relative to mounting face rather than housing rotation. Physical digital-input threshold is strictly >3 V; normalized input registers clamp 0..1. Modes and desired voltages persist across reload.
registers: Original physical address slots 16/24/32/40 of length 8; coil +0 high impedance/+1 output boolean; discrete +1 actual input high; holding +1/+2 IEEE float and +3 uint16 desired output; input registers actual normalized input with original latched low words. Configurable TX/RX radio slots length 4, connected flags, float/uint16 values, max aggregation, real repeater graph and loaded-world range. RX remains read only.
protocol: Original eight functions 01/02/03/04/05/06/0F/10. Complete strict MBAP framing across split/coalesced TCP reads, unsigned addresses/unit IDs, packed multi-coil support and bounded quantities. Corrected original 0F implementation, which incorrectly wrote holding registers. Validate full address range and byte counts before changing any state.
lifecycle: At most eight socket workers and 256 pending requests; only Minecraft server thread reads/writes gates. Capture actual binding identity before enqueueing. Duplicate unit IDs do not displace an existing device. Removed/replaced/unloaded/unticking nodes reject queued commands. Server shutdown closes listener/workers and cancels pending work.
configuration: integration.modbus.enabled=false, host=127.0.0.1, port=1502 by default; port 0 selects an available local port. Source optional creative visibility preserved. No network listener until explicitly enabled. Original housing, opening door, display, power/activity/error indicators and held model.

fullRegression.result: All passed, including Modbus real TCP and independent physical/radio gates, Arc blocks, recycling and dynamic recipes. Computer Probe/Tutorial Sign were installed after this JVM started and are not covered by this result.

finalRegression.scope: All required cases passed. Existing per-device focused/client evidence and its limits remain authoritative; this field does not claim every configuration was exercised.
